name: release-helper
description: Turn an explicit changelog into a concise Markdown release summary. Use when asked to draft release notes, a release announcement, or a Markdown summary from supplied changelog entries.
---

# Release Helper

Use only the changelog content explicitly provided by the user. Do not infer, invent, or look up changes.

1. Identify the release version and date when supplied.
2. Group entries into clear, reader-facing sections such as Added, Changed, Fixed, and Deprecated. Preserve explicit categories when present; otherwise use the smallest useful grouping.
3. Deduplicate overlapping entries and remove implementation-only detail unless it affects users, operators, or upgrade steps.
4. Preserve material compatibility notes, required actions, and known limitations.
5. Write concise Markdown. Use a release title, a one-sentence overview when useful, and short bullets. Omit empty sections.
6. If the changelog is ambiguous or lacks essential release context, state only the uncertainty rather than guessing.

Return the Markdown summary directly unless the user requests another format.
